title_zh: 预约由教练陪同的首次飞行体验

scenario.goal_zh: 核实新手参与方式及教练安排后预约体验

context_zh: 一位没有飞行经验的顾客询问体验课的教练安排并预约。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Can someone with no experience take a trial flight, or is it only for people training to be a pilot?

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: Beginners are welcome. You sit with a qualified instructor, who explains the controls and remains in charge throughout.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: That sounds right for me. Do you have a place on Sunday morning?

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: There is one at ten. The session includes a briefing before the flight.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Please book that place for me.

sentences.speaker: Leila
sentences.text: You are booked for ten on Sunday. I will send the arrival instructions and the weather-cancellation details.
